name: Jerah
title: Son of Joktan
summary: Jerah was one of Joktan's sons, mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis. He is considered one of the patriarchs of the Arab peoples who descended from Shem through Eber and Joktan.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jerah is listed among the sons of Joktan in the genealogy, among the patriarchs of the Semitic peoples on the Arabian Peninsula.
